x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def lcm(a, b):
    return a * b // gcd(a, b)

def compute_difference(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    l = lcm(y1, y2)
    diff = abs((l // y1) * x1 - (l // y2) * x2)
    return diff / l

min_value = 1e9
min_b = 1
t1 = x / y

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    left, right = 1, 1000000
    while right - left > 1:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        t2 = mid / i
        if t2 < t1:
            left = mid
        else:
            right = mid
    candidate = left
    val_left = compute_difference(candidate, i, x, y)
    val_right = compute_difference(right, i, x, y)
    chosen = candidate if val_left < val_right else right
    current_diff = compute_difference(chosen, i, x, y)
    min_diff = compute_difference(min_value, min_b, x, y)
    if current_diff < min_diff:
        min_value = chosen
        min_b = i

print(f"{min_value}/{min_b}")
</translated_code>
